holds: a 60x40x10 plate with two 8mm bores, imported broken and repaired - still the same part

asserts.note: the repair must actually close the mesh - necessary, and nowhere near sufficient

a topology claim, not a size: a negative enclosed volume means the surface is inside out. An inverted mesh is watertight, winding-consistent, and measures every bore correctly - this is the only assertion here that sees it. The bound is deliberately open above so it cannot smuggle in a golden volume.
a repair that moves this is a failed repair, however watertight the result is
fill_holes fans a non-convex boundary; a bore breaking a surface is exactly that
a bore the repair consumed is absent, and an absent feature IS the defect
the gap between the build-plate face and the plate's top face
ADR-8: this part is asserted to be printable in PLA, so a BLOCKER finding is a FAIL here. A WARNING deliberately is not.
